title: Holloway Bros Fishing
specs: Fishing on the McKenzie, Umpqua, Willamette, and coastal rivers near Eugene, Oregon.
Opportunities to catch trout, steelhead, and salmon.

options.name: Trout Trips
options.detail: Guided fly fishing trips targeting trout on the McKenzie and Middle Fork of the Willamette rivers.

options.name: Salmon Trips
options.detail: Guided fly fishing trips targeting salmon with a freshwater fly fishing experience near the coast.

options.name: Steelhead Trips
options.detail: Guided fly fishing trips targeting summer and winter steelhead year-round, including jet boat and float trips.

blurb: Holloway Bros Fishing offers guided fly fishing trips on Oregon's trout, steelhead, and salmon rivers near Eugene. Trips include full and half day guided fly fishing experiences targeting trout, salmon, and steelhead. They provide instruction and guide services for all skill levels, including novices and seasoned anglers.
